sql.if: WHERE INSTR(LOWER(g.group_title), LOWER(#{keyword})) > 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_member gm JOIN member m ON m.member_num = gm.member_num WHERE gm.group_num = g.group_num AND gm.is_leader = 1 AND INSTR(LOWER(m.member_nick), LOWER(#{keyword})) > 0)

mapper.select: SELECT "groupNum", "title", "description", "leader", "isPrivate", "currentMembers", "maxMembers", "createdAt" FROM ( SELECT g.group_num AS "groupNum", g.group_title AS "title", g.group_desc AS "description", (SELECT MAX(m.member_nick) FROM group_member gm JOIN member m ON m.member_num = gm.member_num WHERE gm.group_num = g.group_num AND gm.is_leader = 1) AS "leader", g.group_isPrivate AS "isPrivate", g.group_maxMembers AS "maxMembers", g.created_at AS "createdAt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_member gm WHERE gm.group_num = g.group_num) AS "currentMembers", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY g.group_num DESC) AS rn FROM studygroup g ) WHERE rn BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} ORDER BY rn
SELECT group_num, group_title, group_thumbnail FROM studygroup WHERE group_num = #{num} FOR UPDATE
SELECT DISTINCT member_num FROM group_member WHERE group_num = #{num}
SELECT document_path FROM group_document WHERE group_num = #{num}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_tables WHERE table_name = #{name}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notification WHERE category IN ('JOIN', 'JOIN_APPROVED', 'JOIN_REJECTED') AND REGEXP_LIKE(target_url, '^/group/' || #{num} || '/join-requests\?applicant=[1-9][0-9]*$')
